title: terragucci.audit/v1
description: One line of audit.jsonl at the top of a reports prefix: an approval, apply, policy override, refused wave, state migration or state export. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

id.description: sha256: over where the entry came from; the same records give the same id.

who.description: The approver, the overrider, whoever removed the line, or for an apply the approver it applied under. Null when nobody did.

what.description: The gate (wave-<k>, or a migration's name) or, for an override or a state export, the root.

digest.description: The wave's set digest, or the digest an override binds. Null when a root failed to plan.

detail.description: What else the source says, by kind.
